name: Lady Charlotte
source:
Daughter of a Baron. Love interest of the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url]. Charlotte has lived a very sheltered life. Her only escape has been to dream about the prince she became infatuated with long ago and watching the limited world around her. She has developed a voyeuristic kink, that the MC finds endearing.
